summary: OpenAI published the model spec for GPT-6 Astra, a new top-of-line model with a 1.05M-token context window, reasoning-effort settings up to 'max', and support for coding, computer use, research and document-creation tools.

mechanisms.reason: The model offers a very large context window and reasoning-token support, both of which raise KV-cache and memory content per accelerator.
The spec plainly positions this as OpenAI's new top-of-range model built for the hardest end-to-end tasks, spanning reasoning, coding, computer use and research.
mechanisms.quote: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable model, built for the hardest end-to-end work.

categories.reason: A model window over a million tokens plus reasoning-token generation increases HBM/DRAM capacity demand per accelerator serving it.

practices.reason: A new top-tier model with expanded reasoning effort levels, coding and computer-use tool support changes what an engineering team could build interactively and agentically.
practices.quote: Use it for complex reasoning, coding, computer use, research, and document creation.

practices.reason: Teams migrating to this model must account for its endpoint and tool support matrix, which excludes fine-tuning, embeddings, and several realtime endpoints.

notable_reason: A new frontier-class OpenAI model with a million-token-plus context window and extended reasoning-effort tiers is a significant capability and infrastructure-relevant release.
